meta.discountNote: This run's recall-as-findings must be read against a strongly clustered keep-filter: the kept dispositions concentrate in commit-mechanics, whole-tree gates, test isolation, compose-time verification, watchers, and knowledge-preservation, and recall is correspondingly high there (subsumes/partial). By contrast the multi-agent coordination-protocol and doctrine-traction clusters — COMMIT_EDITMSG single-writer (C07), record-staged full-index fingerprint (C04), identity tuple (C139/C140), claims-open flag friction (C128), presence herd (C142), cron-override (C136), compaction-checkpoint (C214/C137), coordinator over/under-write (C154), pre-execution review value (C95), cycle-split-on-convergence — were surfaced as candidates and then dispositioned kill/held, so the missed verdicts reflect the disposition stage, not a discovery gap. The on-disk pattern library independently confirms several missed baselines have durable graduated homes (e.g. shared-state-topology-is-a-coordinator-question.md, surface-dont-adopt-a-live-peers-name.md, parallel-worktree-dispatch-unreliable.md), so treating any missed baseline here as 'not a real pattern' would be an error. Several matches are also coarse-grain: C01 and C146 each act as generalist attractors absorbing multiple finer single-window baselines, so 'partial' there signals grain loss, not weak overlap.
synthesisNotes: Recall is bimodal: the commit/gate/test/verification/knowledge-preservation baselines were re-found (inherited-state and re-run-git-status-post-gate both subsumed by the broad kept finding C146), while the coordination-protocol and single-window doctrine baselines were largely missed among findings.

The dominant miss driver is disposition, not discovery: most missed or partial baselines map cleanly onto candidates the run surfaced then killed (C07, C04, C128, C142, C136, C214/C137, C154, C95, C163), so raw discovery recall materially exceeds recall-as-kept-findings.

C146 is a generalist attractor — it subsumes both inherited-state-is-a-hypothesis and re-run-git-status-post-gate at coarser grain and carries verified graduated homes (feel-state-of-completion-preceding-evidence-of-completion.md, re-derive-session-persistent-state.md).

C01 partially covers three distinct commit-attribution baselines (single-agent-assumption, autofix-sweep, record-staged-fingerprint); the finer tooling-specific mechanisms behind each (C03 auto-fix hook promotion, C04 record-staged, C07 COMMIT_EDITMSG) were all killed, so these are partials, never equal or subsumes.

capture-does-not-cure is only half re-found: kept C185 supplies the enforce-edge/no-op-actuator diagnosis, but the vivid behavioural claim that naming a failure does not inoculate against repeating it same-session sits in killed C184/C183 and the kept instance C118.

Reviewer patterns split by polarity: the distrust-the-reviewer baselines (C89/C98, kept, homed at verify-dont-trust.md and verify-before-propagating.md) were re-found, whereas the positive value baselines — pre-execution-catch (C95) and cycle-split-on-convergence — were killed or absent, so 'what reviewers add' recall lags 'why to verify reviewers'.

Corroboration is robust and confirms these keeps are re-discoveries of already-graduated doctrine rather than novel findings: the commit/gate/test/verification/watcher/knowledge cluster maps onto existing .agent/rules and .agent/memory/active/patterns homes with high confidence.

Trajectory and emergent-coordination baselines fared worst overall; the kept set skews toward stable recurrences with existing enforcement homes, suggesting the run's keep-filter under-weights protocol-evolution and single-window mechanism patterns.
